<?php

use Illuminate\Database\Migrations\Migration;

final class Subject
{
    /** Stays with the private static method. */
    #[Deprecated]
    private static function hiddenFactory(): string { return 'private static'; } // Factory comment.

    protected static function factory(): string { return 'protected static'; }

    private function hidden(): string { return 'private'; }

    protected function helper(): string { return 'protected'; }

    public function zebra(): string { return 'first public'; }

    public function alpha(): string { return 'second public'; }

    public static function make(): string { return 'public static'; }

    private function __construct() {}
}

trait SubjectTrait
{
    private static function hiddenFactory(): void {}

    private function hidden(): void {}

    public function run(): void {}
}

interface SubjectInterface
{
    public function run(): void;

    public static function make(): self;
}

enum SubjectState
{
    case Active;

    protected static function factory(): void {}

    protected function helper(): void {}

    public function run(): void {}
}

$object = new class {
    private static function factory(): void {}

    public function run(): void {}
};

return new class extends Migration {
    public function down(): void {}

    public function up(): void {}

    public function getConnection(): ?string { return null; }
};
